# Pine Tree Learning Hub

> Pine Tree Learning Hub is a children's art school in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, offering weekend clay art and drawing classes for children aged 4 to 12 at two branches: Taman Molek and Mutiara Rini. Art materials are included, every finished piece goes home, and structured levels with certificates recognise each child's progress. Pine Tree also runs creative workshops for schools, malls, birthdays and companies across Johor. Slogan: Explore · Learn · Grow.

Key facts:

- Ages: 4 to 12
- Classes: Clay Art Level 1, Clay Art Level 2, Drawing Course
- Schedule: weekend classes. Contact Pine Tree on WhatsApp for current class times and fees.
- Trial classes: available, book on WhatsApp
- Materials: all art materials included; every finished piece goes home
- Certificates: certificate of completion at each level
- Languages: English and Malay
- Phone and WhatsApp: +60 11-3660 2096 (https://wa.me/601136602096)
- Website: https://pinetreelearninghub.com/
- Founder: Elynn Wong

## Locations

- [Pine Tree Learning Hub Taman Molek](https://share.google/22U3CTpWmv0Kdsycc): at Brilliant Stars Preschool, Taman Molek, Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. Google listing with directions and reviews.
- [Pine Tree Learning Hub Mutiara Rini](https://share.google/lBXb8PNnRusYEvke7): at Lotus's Mutiara Rini, inside Seven Castle playground, Mutiara Rini, Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. Google listing with directions and reviews.

## Programmes

- [Clay Art · Level 1](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#programmes): shaping, colour mixing and fun clay miniatures. The starting level for clay.
- [Clay Art · Level 2](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#programmes): bigger scenes and finer detail, for children who have completed Level 1.
- [Drawing Course](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#drawing): lines, shapes and colour, from first sketches to finished artwork.
- [Friendly competitions](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#programmes): art competitions within a hub (intra-hub), between Pine Tree hubs (inter-hub) and open to the public.
- [Class information](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#class-info): weekend classes at Taman Molek and Mutiara Rini; message Pine Tree for times, fees and trial classes.

## Workshops and events

- [Workshops & events](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#workshops): themed craft workshops, parent-child activities, school holiday workshops, birthday and private events, corporate family days, sessions for schools and kindergartens, and collaborative art projects.
- [Durian City Farm workshops](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#workshops): Pine Tree runs hands-on creative and educational activities for visitors at Durian City Farm.
- [Partners & past events](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/partners.html): Pine Tree has run workshops and activities with 29 organisations across Johor, including AEON, Tsutaya Bookstore AEON Tebrau City, Paradigm Mall Johor Bahru, Angsana Johor Bahru Mall, Raffles American School, Stellar International School, Invictus International School, Happy Fish Swim School and Durian City Farm.

## Frequently asked questions

- [FAQ](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#faq): answers about ages, classes, locations, materials, trial classes, fees, certificates and workshops.
- What ages are classes for? Children aged 4 to 12.
- Are art materials included? Yes. All materials are included, and every finished piece goes home.
- Can my child try a class first? Yes. Trial classes are available; book on WhatsApp at +60 11-3660 2096.
- How much do classes cost? Contact Pine Tree on WhatsApp at +60 11-3660 2096 for current fees and times.
- Do children receive a certificate? Yes, a certificate of completion at each level.
- Do you run workshops for schools, birthdays and companies? Yes, across Johor.

## About

- [About Pine Tree](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/about.html): mission (to nurture children's creativity and artistic abilities through meaningful, engaging and hands-on learning experiences), vision (to inspire a generation of confident, imaginative young learners who explore their potential through art) and learning journey: discover, learn, practise, create, progress.
- [Meet the founder](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/#founder): Elynn Wong, founder of Pine Tree Learning Hub, HRD Corp Accredited Trainer and Adjunct Lecturer. Master of Education (M.Ed.), with over 10 years of experience in Early Childhood Education. She also runs professional development for educators and experiential training programmes for organisations.

## Merchandise

- [Merchandise](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/merchandise.html): original clay figurines and Kids Modelling Clay designed and handmade by the Pine Tree team. Current collection: Historical Series (prehistoric friends with palm trees, volcanoes and dinosaur eggs). Coming soon: Local Authentic Food series. Stockists and bulk orders via WhatsApp.

## Join us

- [Licensing and careers](https://pinetreelearninghub.com/grow.html): open a Pine Tree Learning Hub (structured clay and drawing curriculum, teacher training, brand and set-up guidance, operations system, parent progress tracking), or join the team as an art teacher (clay and drawing) or workshop and event facilitator, full-time or part-time.
